verdict.rationale: Delaware's franchise-tax entry page states its credential up front: you enter a Business Entity File Number, plus a saved-session ID only if you have one, and it links to a name search for finding that number. The page shows no account requirement and an image CAPTCHA gate. Formation is described as fillable PDFs submitted via the filing service, upload, fax or mail, with no stated account step. Missing for 10: a consolidated pre-start statement of all account, credential and identity-proofing requirements across formation and filing; any documented identity-proofing policy; a statement on whether the Document Filing Service needs an account; the CAPTCHA disclosed in docs rather than only seen on the page; independent or hands-on confirmation that no other gates appear mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: Please enter your Business Entity File Number below to start filing your Annual Report or Pay Taxes
Please also enter your 15 digit saved session ID number below (only if you have previously saved a session)
Need your business entity number? Search for your business by name
The entity forms are PDF fillable and can be submitted using our Document Filing and Certificate Request Service or by mail.
